reason: In sync mode `parseRefreshTokenResponse` uses `minimumTokenResponseSchema` (packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts:5-11,15-16), whose two computed keys both evaluate to "[object Object]", so the default-stripping `z.object` keeps only `access_token` and drops `expires_in`. packages/app-store/zoomvideo/lib/VideoApiAdapter.ts:122 then computes `Date.now() + undefined * 1000` = NaN and persists it as `expiry_date`, so the next `zoomTokenSchema.parse(credential.key)` at line 132 fails on `expiry_date: z.number()`.
